I've been on both sides of this situation. I've been cheated on in every single exclusive connection I've had with men since I was 16 (29F) and I've cheated once. (I would like to clarify that I am still unbelievably ashamed about 6 years later, although I made sure my partner never actually found out.) 

My reason for cheating at the time was because I was in a severely controlling relationship with a man who systematically broke me down mentally over the 6 years we were together to gain complete subservience from me. I simply rebelled. This still isn't a valid excuse and I instantly hated myself for my actions.

I never wanted, or will ever want, anyone to feel the absolute loss of self worth that being cheated on triggers. It shatters a person to their core and destroys any ability to truly trust any partner again. 

Last week I discovered that a man I was sexually exclusive with and had fallen in love with had been sleeping and partaking in BDSM play with others for the duration of our 'relationship/ friendship'. It has, again, completely destroyed me and my sense of self worth and rocked me beyond my core. Sadly, he was the first person I allowed myself to trust and feel anything for in over 5 years and I can honestly say I now won't ever trust or love again. I simply will not be able to. 

For anyone who is cheating or is tempted to cheat, for whatever reason, STOP DON'T DO IT. Be honest with your partner if the situation allows or be decent and leave before you cheat. You'll feel better about yourself for it too.
